definitions.short: an earthen vessel ; usually (painful) toil ; also a pang (whether of body or mind)
definitions.full: H6089. etseb I. עֶ֫צֶב noun [masculine] pain, hurt, toil ; — 1 ׳ע pain Gen 3:16 (of travail), Prov 10:22 . 2 hurt (of mind), ׳דְּבַרעֿ Prov 15:1 a word that hurts (opposed to מַעֲנֶהרַֿךְ ). 3 toil Prov 14:23 ; plural הָעֲצָבִים לֶחֶם Psa 127:2 bread of (gained by) toils ; suffix עֲצָבֶיךָ Prov 5:10 . II. עֶ֫צֶב noun masculine vessel (as fashioned ); — וגו ׳נִבְזֶה ׳י Jer 22:28 a vessel despised , etc. (figurative of Coniah = Jehoiachin).
